title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans: The Plan Unit, Coverage Tier and One Monthly Premium
content:
### Billing desk guidance — Prepaid Dental HMO Plans

**The rule.** All DHMO enrollments of one subscriber on the same billing account form one plan unit with the same plan and coverage tier and are charged one monthly premium for the coverage tier. A voluntary termination of the subscriber's enrollment ends every enrollment of the unit on the same date; a dependent's enrollment may be ended alone, which changes the coverage tier and the premium from the first of the following month.

**What makes a plan unit.** The enrollments belong to one subscriber and are funded by the same billing account. Within the unit every enrollment carries the same Cascade DentalCare DHMO plan and the same coverage tier.

**What the unit is charged.** One monthly premium, for the unit's coverage tier, at the rate for that plan and coverage tier. The premium figures each plan uses are the product's monthly premium rates by coverage tier: the member-only monthly premium and the family monthly premium are the two figures this rule names for every plan, from the Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 to the 715. The premium is charged once for the unit, not once per enrolled person.

**How enrollments of the unit end.**

| What ends | Effect on the other enrollments of the unit | Effect on coverage tier and premium |
|---|---|---|
| The subscriber's own enrollment, by voluntary termination | Every enrollment of the unit ends on the same date | The unit ends |
| One dependent's enrollment alone | The other enrollments continue | The coverage tier and the premium change from the first of the following month |

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A subscriber, a spouse and two children are enrolled on one billing account on the same Cascade DentalCare DHMO plan at the family coverage tier. One family monthly premium is charged for the four enrollments.
- In that unit, one child's enrollment is ended alone during October. The coverage tier and the premium change from 1 November; the other three enrollments continue.
- In the same unit the subscriber instead ends the subscriber's own enrollment voluntarily. The spouse's and both children's enrollments end on the same date as the subscriber's.
